acceptanceCriteria: ADR-0042 and its ADR-index entry remain Proposed. SPEC, CONTEXT, HANDOFF, public docs, package manifests, fixtures, CLI, release manifests, and ADR-0039 retain the accepted pre-decision package graph until a committed protocol-v2 PASS record and separate authority projection.
The beta.2 public package inventory is exactly questpie and questpie-opentelemetry at one version. questpie/react is an export subpath, not a third npm package.

questpie declares React ^19.2.0 as an optional peer. Root and every non-React subpath remain importable without React or OpenTelemetry and do not import, initialize, bundle, or expose React-only declarations.

questpie/react retains the accepted one-hook useSyncExternalStore projection and owns no cache, identity, transport, retry, invalidation, Context, credentials, provider, SSR, Suspense, hydration, ReactDOM, or fallback behavior.

questpie-opentelemetry exact-peers the same-version questpie package, preserves the accepted opaque observation boundary, and remains absent from core. The CLI resolves only questpie-opentelemetry from the application root and fails before readiness under the existing semantics.

The obsolete @questpie/react and @questpie/opentelemetry identities are deleted during the post-PASS breaking vertical. No alias, forwarding package, re-export, diagnostic suggestion, CLI fallback, or compatibility path remains.

The supersession is limited to package spelling, placement, peer metadata, CLI resolution specifier, and release cardinality/archive clauses of ADR-0033 and ADR-0035 and their projections. Their React, Query Resource, observation, propagation, durable-link, flush, shutdown, failure, and disclosure kernels remain unchanged.

Native package-manager and loader diagnostics are tool-owned. QUESTPIE-owned CLI, release, and startup diagnostics disclose only the canonical identity, safe expected version or peer range, and mismatch class, with no credentials, search history, environment, Context, or payload.

The isolated prototype proves candidate topology, twice-identical candidate archives, relocated offline candidate installs, import behavior, and declared peer-range mismatch rejection. It does not claim production migration, deterministic production archives, production declaration digests, exhaustive active deletion, PostgreSQL/browser evidence, or beta.2 release readiness; PPI-01 through PPI-08 own those post-PASS gates.
